spans.s:
परु परु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ), a
limb, member; a knot or joint in a reed; a moun-
tain; the ocean; the sky, paradise.

पारु पारु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 3. पा),
the sun; fire (= पेरु).

परु-शस् or परुश्-शस्, Ved. limb by limb,
member by member.

परुष, अस्, आ, अम्, (in the earlier language, f.
परुष्णी), containing knots, knotted (Ved.); spotted,
variegated, party-coloured; dirty; rough, rugged,
uneven, shaggy; keen, piercing (as the wind);
harsh, discordant; unkind, cruel, stern, hard, severe,
[]
abusive, contumelious; coarse, gross; churlish, cruel,
unkind; (अस्), m. a reed (Ved.); an arrow (Ved.);
= परूष, q. v.; (आ), f. a kind of riddle; (ष्णी),
f., Ved. ‘much indented’ or ‘winding’ or ‘reedy,’
N. of one of the rivers of the Pañjāb, in later times
called Irā-vatī, and at the present day Rāvī; a
cloud?; (अम्), n. harsh and contumelious speech,
abuse; a species of Barleria with blue flowers; =
परूष, q. v.; (आणि), n. pl. rough or harsh or
stern words.
—परुष-त्व, अम्, n. roughness,
harshness.
—परुष-वचन, अम्, n. harsh language,
harsh or contumelious speech, reproach, abuse.
—प-
रुष-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, harsh-spoken; (क्), f. harsh or
contumelious speech.
—परुषाक्षर (˚ष-अक्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘harsh-worded,’ harsh.
—परुषाह्व
(˚ष-आह्˚), अस्, m., Ved. a species of reed.
—परुषी-
कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spotted, soiled, stained; treated
roughly.
—परुषेतर (˚ष-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, other
than rough, bright, light, beaming, mild.
—परु-
षोक्ति (˚ष-उक्˚), इस्, f. abusive or harsh language.
—परुषोक्तिक, अस्, m. an abuser, one uttering
harsh and scurrilous language.
परुष परुष. See under परु, col. 2.

परूष or परूषक, अस्, m. Grewia Asiatica
(from the berries of which a cooling beverage is pre-
pared; Bengāli फलसा; Hindūstānī پهالسا ac-
cording to others) Xylocarpus Granatum = Bengāli,
परुष; (अम्), n. the fruit of this tree.

परुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, treated roughly or harshly,
subjected to rude treatment.

परुषिमन्, आ, m., Ved. a rough or shaggy
appearance.

परुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. party-coloured, varie-
gated, piebald.

पारुष्य, अम्, n. roughness [cf. त्वक्-प्˚], harsh-
ness; harshness of language, abuse, reproach, con-
tumelious or scurrilous language, opprobrious or
unfriendly speech, insult; violence (in word or deed,
cf. दण्ड-प्˚, वाक्-प्˚); squalor; the forest or grove
of Indra; aloe wood or Agallochum; (अस्), m. a N.
of Bṛhas-pati, the planet Jupiter.

परुस्, उस्, n., Ved. a knot or joint of a cane or
reed; a member of the body, limb; a joint, junction;
a part cut off, portion.
—परुः-स्रंस, अस्, m., Ved.
fracture of a joint or limb.

परुच्छेप परु-च्छेप, अस्, m. (perhaps irre-
gularly formed fr. परुस् + क्षेप), N. of a Ṛṣi,
son of Divo-dāsa and author of the hymns Ṛg-
veda
sqq.

परुत् परुत्, ind. (fr. पर + वत्?, occur-
ring only in comp.), last year; [cf. Gr. πέρυσι, Dor.
πέρυτι, πέρυτις: Old Germ. vert, vernent, vern,
‘last year:’ Goth. fairni-s, ‘old;’ fairnyō yēr, ‘the
old year.’]

परुद्वार परुद्वार or परुल, अस्, m. a
horse; [cf. Lat. paraveredus.]
पारुच्छेपि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Parucchepa.

पारुषक पारुषक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a species of flower; [cf. परूषक.]

पारुषेय पारुषेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. परुष),
Ved. spotted, freckled.

पारुष्ण पारुष्ण, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of
bird.
